verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe live preview with visual controls ('Fine-tune every detail with visual controls and live preview'), preview deployments built from working branches with unique URLs distinct from production, and only explicit publish/deploy actions push to production — matching the founder's workflow of iterating on a live preview before publishing. Community evidence corroborates fast, iterative building experience. missing for 10: independent hands-on account specifically describing interacting with the live preview UI (vs. general speed/quality feedback), and no detail on preview interactivity limits.
